agents.title: Mandate and instrument intake
agents.purpose: Turn the investor request into a specific research mandate without inventing climate objectives.

agents.title: Evidence and entity-boundary analyst
agents.purpose: Build the common evidence base and prevent entity, date, unit and scope mismatches.

agents.title: Climate science and materiality analyst
agents.purpose: Identify which climate mechanisms could matter for this investment and at what horizon.

agents.title: Policy and disclosure context analyst
agents.purpose: Translate relevant disclosure and policy context into dated analytical inputs, not political judgments.

agents.title: Emissions, metrics and targets analyst
agents.purpose: Produce comparable climate metrics without confusing footprint, risk and real-world impact.

agents.title: Physical risk, adaptation and resilience analyst
agents.purpose: Translate location-specific hazards and adaptive capacity into investment-relevant exposures.

agents.title: Transition risk and climate-solutions analyst
agents.purpose: Assess how business models and competitive economics change under specified transitions.

agents.title: Scenario design and model-risk analyst
agents.purpose: Select coherent what-if pathways appropriate to the mandate rather than predict one climate future.

agents.title: Financial transmission and double-counting controller
agents.purpose: Connect the shared climate analysis to financial models through explicit and non-duplicated channels.

agents.title: Listed equity valuation analyst
agents.purpose: Produce an equity-specific climate-integrated valuation, not an ESG score relabelled as a price target.

agents.title: Corporate bond and credit analyst
agents.purpose: Evaluate repayment capacity, legal recourse and price risk separately from climate labels.

agents.title: Sovereign bond analyst
agents.purpose: Assess sovereign financial exposures without turning country analysis into political rankings.

agents.title: Municipal and sub-sovereign bond analyst
agents.purpose: Connect geographically concentrated climate exposures to the bond’s actual repayment source.

agents.title: Green, sustainability-linked and transition bond analyst
agents.purpose: Assess label integrity and climate contribution alongside, not instead of, obligor credit quality.

agents.title: Structured credit and listed real-asset analyst
agents.purpose: Trace physical and transition risk through collateral and contractual structure.

agents.title: Portfolio construction and attribution analyst
agents.purpose: Aggregate decision-relevant exposures while preserving financial and climate objectives separately.

agents.title: Stewardship and engagement planner
agents.purpose: Convert material research gaps into measurable issuer-engagement objectives.

agents.title: Monitoring and thesis-maintenance analyst
agents.purpose: Define how the decision should be revisited as evidence and exposures evolve.

agents.title: Independent challenge and release-control analyst
agents.purpose: Challenge the thesis and enforce evidence, scope and arithmetic controls before investment review.

agents.title: Investment committee and client-reporting editor
agents.purpose: Synthesize the reviewed work into a decision document accountable to the mandate.
